title: excerpts.jsonl - one line of a run's excerpt record (experimental)
description: runs/<id>/excerpts.jsonl, appended by src/excerpt-record.js: one JSON object per line. An excerpt of project text the seats were shown, or a request for such text that was declined, left unanswered, withheld or not cut by the harness, or a read of the handling session that the harness could not cut (a session_read line with status not_cut). `text` is the exact text shown after any edit, and the prompt block is built from it. A request without text has text, text_sha256, file_sha256 and scans null. `answered_stage` names the stage whose answer carried the text or the decline; it names, for a request left unanswered, the stage at whose pause it was left out, and is null only when no pause came after the request.

schema.description: The version of this line's format, as the other run-folder records carry theirs.

id.description: E-<n>, numbered in the order recorded.

request_kind.description: seat_read is reserved for a later seat that reads the project itself; it has the same fields.

requested_by.description: The requesting seat's key; null for a session_read.

origin.description: The label of the reply that carried the request (for example panel-1-<seat key> for a judge's verdict or debate-<seat key> for a proposer's debate reply); it tells apart two seats that share a key. null for a session_read.

text.description: The exact text shown. It may be empty or only whitespace when the named lines hold no text (an empty file, a blank range); null when the line carries no text.

pasted_by.description: main-session for a request the handling session answered with a paste or a decline; null for a session read and for a request left unanswered or not cut.

answered_stage.description: The stage whose answer carried the text or the decline: for a session_read, the stage whose answer the session was writing when it read the file; for a request, the stage at whose pause the session answered. The text is shown in every prompt from the next stage on. For a request left unanswered, the stage at whose pause it was left out; null only when no pause came after the request. For a line the harness could not cut (not_cut), the stage whose answer named the text.

personal_data.description: not_scanned: no personal-data check ran during the run (the check at the start applies); the entry does not claim a pass.

status.description: not_cut: the harness could not cut the text the request or the read named (the path is outside the project, a secret file, not found, the lines do not fit, the text is too long for an approval screen); the reason says which. Nobody declined it and nobody left it out.

actor.description: As the gate ledger recorded it: the operating-system user name for cli, the MCP client's name for elicitation, main-session for session; null when the gate recorded none.

reason.description: The decliner's or the refuser's own words; null when none was given (a refusal's reason is optional), never an empty string. Required for unanswered, withheld and not_cut.

supersedes.description: Optional, absent on almost every line. The id of an earlier line recorded not_required that this line replaces: that earlier text was recorded while the privacy switch was off and no call on the run's record had sent it to a seat, so it was held for the person when the switch was turned on, and this line holds the answer (or not_cut, for a text longer than an approval screen can hold). The earlier line stays in the file; it is no longer used.
